name: Garreson Bistec
source:
Butler of the Rivale family since before [url=/c56367]Klinon[/url] was born. He is traveling with her and accompanies her songs on a magical instrument called Fortel ([url=http://www.asmusic.jp/ASHARD/Palais/basic.html]フォルテール[/url], something like a keyboard instrument)

[Translated from the game's [url=https://www.success-corp.co.jp/software/ps2/angelicconcert/src/angelic_charaframe.htm]Official Homepage[/url].]
